name: Language Checker
author: roychassi
description: Turns down releases HolyArrs refuses for a missing audio language, so they are blocklisted for that movie or episode and searched again.
long_description: HolyArrs reads the real audio tracks of a download when it imports it. If a Version requires audio languages (for example English, Japanese or French) and the tracks don't show one, the file is refused and waits in Needs a decision. This plugin turns that release down for that movie or episode, so HolyArrs blocklists it and searches again. It stops after a set number of files per movie or episode and leaves the last one for you. It reads no media, deletes nothing and needs no outside network access. Set Required audio languages on the title first; the plugin only acts on that refusal.
how_it_works: Set Required audio languages on a title, such as en or ja. HolyArrs then checks the real audio tracks at import.
A file missing a required language is refused and waits in Needs a decision.
The plugin turns that release down for that movie or episode, and HolyArrs searches again.
After Max tries files on one movie or episode, it stops and tells you. Search again by hand, or raise Max tries.
It starts in dry run: it only alerts until you switch Dry run off.

settings.label: Dry run
settings.help: On: only alert about what would be turned down. Off: turn releases down and search again.

settings.label: Max tries per movie or episode
settings.help: Files tried per movie or episode. The last one stays in Needs a decision. Raise this to let it carry on.

settings.label: Check every (seconds)
settings.help: How often to look at Needs a decision. 30 to 3600.

settings.label: Send alerts
settings.help: Send a message through your HolyArrs alerts that take plugin messages.

settings.label: Refusal text to match
settings.default: does not establish every language required
settings.help: Part of HolyArrs' own refusal message. Change it only if HolyArrs rewords that message.
